test1.script:
read_verilog -icells input.v
synth_intel -family cycloneiv -top test1 -run begin:map_cells
write_rtlil checkpoint.il
write_json checkpoint.json
techmap -map +/intel/cycloneiv/cells_map.v
clean -purge
check -noinit -assert
write_rtlil final.il
write_json final.json

write_rtlil -selected checkpoint.il
